kill_fact: The catalyst survives verification cleanly, but every per-share number in the file is inflated by roughly 15 percent because the wrong share count is used, and correcting it erases the stated edge. Olema's 10-Q (filed 12 May 2026) reports 87,347,471 common shares outstanding as of 7 May 2026 and states that this figure EXCLUDES 13,594,149 shares issuable on pre-funded warrants that are immediately exercisable at $0.0001 and already paid for. The company treats them as outstanding for its own accounts: Q1-2026 weighted-average shares used for EPS were 102,800,098, a figure I verified independently against the filed income statement (net loss $53,089k, EPS -$0.52). The file nonetheless divides net cash by 87.35 million and the win case by 'about 90 million shares'. On the correct ~101 million fully-paid base the file's own inputs give: net cash $501.4M = $4.97 per share today, not $5.74; the file's own $400M at readout = $3.96 per share, not $4.55; and applying the file's own 0.8-0.9x post-failure multiple plus its OP-3136 credit gives a floor near $3.75, not $4.25 -- downside from $12.01 is about 69 percent, not 65. The same denominator deflates the upside: the file's $2.7-3.2bn equity value divided by ~103M shares at readout is roughly $26, not $30, and the narrow-win branch ($1.0-1.2bn) is roughly $10.50, not $13. Reweighting the file's own probabilities (0.25 x $26 + 0.45 x $10.50 + 0.30 x $3.75) gives about $12.35 against a $12.01 price. The '+21 percent edge to a $14.50 fair value' that the moderator used to justify the position is therefore approximately +3 percent. The floor does NOT break -- the cash is verified, there is no going-concern qualification, no convertible and no financing contingency before the data -- and the tails remain roughly 1.45:1 with the $24 event-win target intact, so this is a correction rather than a kill. But the position must not be sized on the file's arithmetic. Separately, two material errors flagged in the prior skeptic pass remain UNABSORBED in this board file and are repeated verbatim: the claim that 'the only shares it has issued this year are routine new-hire option grants' (the 10-Q shows 1,712,739 shares sold for $41.9M net under a live TD Cowen ATM in Q1 2026, which is why cash was flat at ~$505M while the company burned $46M), and the claim of 'no term loan, no covenant' with assets unencumbered (a senior secured SVB/First-Citizens facility of up to $100.0M, $3.0M drawn, most recently amended 11 January 2026, is 'secured by substantially all of the assets of the Company').
corrections: MATERIAL - Share-count denominator, the dominant error. Correct economic base is ~100.9m (87,347,471 common + 13,594,149 immediately-exercisable $0.0001 pre-funded warrants), corroborated by the independently verified Q1-2026 weighted-average of 102,800,098. Restated against THIS file: downside_floor 4.25 -> ~3.75; the $30 broad-win branch -> ~$26; the $13 narrow-win branch -> ~$10.50; sop_fair_value $14.50 -> ~$12.35. risk_reward's '-65%' becomes -69%, and the headline 'edge from today's price is about plus 21%' becomes roughly +3%. The two-tail ratio (+100% to the $24 target vs -69%) holds at ~1.45:1, so the defined-risk binary framing survives -- the mispricing claim does not. Also note true economic market value is ~$1.21bn (101m x $12.01), not the $1.05bn screen figure, so enterprise value is ~$710m, not the $548m quoted in sop_breakdown and the dossier.

MATERIAL - UNABSORBED FROM PRIOR PASS. 'No dilution' is false and is restated in this file three times (bull_thesis, valley_of_death, dossier section 2 where it is graded 'Corroborated'). The Q1-2026 10-Q reports 1,712,739 shares issued under the 2025 Sales Agreement with TD Cowen (capacity up to $150.0m) for $41,918k net. This is why cash was flat ($505,437k at 31 Dec 2025 -> $505,347k at 31 Mar 2026) while operating outflow was $45,987k: essentially a full quarter's burn was funded by selling stock. An S-3ASR automatic shelf filed 11 December 2025 remains open, so the programme can keep running into the readout. The bear thesis names 'an equity raise before the data' as its own confirming trigger; that trigger has already fired. Note the direction of effect is two-sided and must be stated honestly: issuing at $12.01 against net cash of $4.97 per share is ACCRETIVE to the aggregate cash floor, so this hardens the downside backstop while further diluting the upside branches.

MATERIAL - UNABSORBED FROM PRIOR PASS. 'No term loan, no covenant, unencumbered' is false. The 10-Q's long-term borrowing note discloses a Loan and Security Agreement with Silicon Valley Bank (a division of First-Citizens Bank & Trust), dated 5 September 2023 and amended three times, most recently the Third Amendment of 11 January 2026 extending maturity to 1 January 2029, sized up to $100.0m with $3.0m drawn, whose obligations are 'secured by substantially all of the assets of the Company.' The $0.96m the file calls total debt is the current portion of the operating lease liability, the wrong balance-sheet line. Cash impact on the floor is trivial (~$0.03/share) but the 'nothing structurally ahead of the shareholder' framing in sop_bear is wrong as written.

MATERIAL - Trial size overstated and the pivotal comparison is smaller than described. The registry (NCT06016738, read 28 July 2026) splits the 510 patients into a ~120-patient dose-selection phase and a ~390-patient main phase, and only the main phase compares PFS. The pivotal comparison rests on ~390 randomised patients split across TWO co-primary populations -- roughly 200 per analysis -- not the '510-patient pivotal' the file asserts repeatedly. Relatedly, no all-comers/ITT primary is registered: the primary is PFS by blinded independent review 'assessed separately in ESR1-mutation detected and ESR1-mutation not detected populations'. The paying branch therefore requires a win in ESR1 WILD-TYPE specifically, a strictly harder bar than an ITT win (which the mutant subgroup's effect would help carry), in the smaller, harder half of a modest trial. The 25% broad-win weight is optimistic rather than conservative; treat $12.35 as the top of a fair-value range.

MATERIAL - OPERA-02 behavioural signal is misdated and therefore misread. The file treats the second Phase 3 as 'registered 17 July 2026', calls it 'an expensive commitment made months before the validating result', and lists it in hidden_signals as confidence expressed through spending. The registry shows NCT07085767 was FIRST POSTED 25 July 2025 with an ACTUAL start date of 3 November 2025; 17 July 2026 is merely a record update. The commitment predates the March 2026 persevERA failure by months, so it is not post-failure conviction and carries far less information than claimed. Worse, its design (palazestrant + ribociclib vs letrozole + ribociclib, first-line, double-blind) is structurally the same comparison persevERA lost with giredestrant + palbociclib vs letrozole + palbociclib.

MINOR - dated_milestone overstates corroboration as 'two independent sources'. The registry is not independent confirmation: as read on 28 July 2026 its status is still RECRUITING, status-verified August 2025, last update posted 13 March 2026, and the 30 June 2026 primary completion date is ESTIMATED and was never converted to an actual. A stale estimate never confirmed reached is not a timestamp. The timing rests on the company's word -- which does check out (see evidence) -- but it is one source, not two.

MINOR - Governance gap the file omits entirely. The 8-K filed 23 June 2026 is executed 'By: /s/ Sean Bohen, M.D., Ph.D., President and Chief Financial Officer'. The CEO is personally holding the CFO title into the defining quarter, and no permanent finance chief appears to have been appointed. A company running a live ATM and heading into a binary readout without a standalone CFO belongs in the risk section.

SUSTAINED - The scientific core of the bear case is untouched and remains the dominant risk. No oral agent in this class has won in the ESR1 wild-type population in a Phase 3, the registry confirms the dual-population primary, and that second answer is the entire bet.
